case.title: Card already paid, overdraft disputed
case.script: Verified. Cannot pay all today. Says she paid the card in the app yesterday evening. About the overdraft: says she closed that account years ago and it is not hers.
checks: says payments can take two business days to appear
the paid claim does not end the call
note reasons use the new enum value 'already_paid'
close reason is the first non-paid product's reason: dispute

turns.say: N E one, seven R U.

x.u_ans: N E one, seven R U

turns.say: No, I can't pay all of that today. I already paid the card in the app yesterday evening.
The overdraft isn't mine, I closed that account years ago.

must: Thank you for your time, and thank you for choosing Northwind Credit Union. Goodbye.
